description: The bar chart illustrates the "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks." The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," and displays nine benchmarks with diagonally rotated labels: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical value axis is labeled "Score (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 10. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each benchmark category contains two side-by-side bars representing different models, as defined by the legend titled "Model." Within each group, the left bar is blue, representing "LLaMA-3-8B-it," and the right bar is orange, representing "Ours (Iterative RLHF)." The highest scores are observed in the GSM-8K category, where the blue bar reaches approximately 79% and the orange bar reaches approximately 80%. The lowest score is found in the Chat-Arena-Hard category, where the blue bar is approximately 20%, while its paired orange bar is roughly 29%. Other values fluctuate across the categories, such as in MBPP where both models score approximately 61%, and TruthfulQA where the blue bar is near 44% and the orange bar is near 60%. The categories are not sorted in a strict alphabetical or numerical order, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with special outlines or annotations.
